text:
tim: Heads-up — ACMEcorp reporting p99 token timeouts on their Dedicated pool since 07:10. Customer flagged SLA risk for EOD Friday. Need owners + a short-term workaround ASAP.

maria: Looks like KV cache thrash after the model rollout this morning. My read: pin them to the previous model and flush KV cache. @alex can you own the rollback?

alex: I can take the rollback. Need PR + confirm routing change sequence. What customer id and incident number?

jordan: ACME customer id ACME-4321. CS already opened INC-9876 and notified the account team with an EOD risk callout.

samantha: Two immediate blockers for rollback: 1) infra DB migration is scheduled to land at 09:00 and updates routing_table; 2) canary traffic is still live. If we rollback we must stop canary first or risk split-brain.

tim: Plan: alex -> rollback, samantha -> coordinate pause of infra migration window, maria -> prepare model artifact + KV cache flush script. Jordan -> coordinate customer comms.

alex: Opening PR and tagging reviewers @maria @samantha. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5682

alex: Rollback dry-run command:
```bash
tools/deploy rollback --customer ACME-4321 --model redwood-v2-2025-06 --target previous
```

devops-bot: deploy-bot: Initiated dry-run rollback for ACME-4321 by alex at 07:35 — dry-run success.

oncall-bot: incident-bot: INC-9876 created and linked to thread (severity: P1).

maria: KV cache flush ready: scripts/cache_flush.sh — will execute after rollback success and will monitor latencies.

samantha: Infra agreed to pause migration window 08:50-09:10. I'll add calendar invite and DM infra lead.

alex: CR reviewers — need approvals by 08:00 to land hotfix at 08:15. ping @maria @samantha.

tim: Decision: short-term rollback + cache flush in 08:15 window. Long-term: create follow-up to fix routing space leak. Owner for follow-up: @maria.

jordan: @tim please confirm CS should notify customer 10m before rollback. They want a heads-up.

tim: Confirmed. CS to send pre-rollback notice at 08:05. Post-rollback status by 08:30 with p50/p99 numbers.

maria: I'll attach post-rollback p50/p99 dashboards to the thread and watch for regressions.

alex: Approvals: @samantha approved, @maria requested a tiny nit in PR -> fixed. Merging now.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: Started rollback for ACME-4321 at 08:16. Rolling back model to redwood-v2-2025-05. ETA ~6m.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 08:23. Smoke tests passed.

maria: Cache flush executed at 08:25. p99 for ACME dedicated pool fell from ~1200ms -> ~180ms. :tada:

jordan: CS updated customer (INC-9876) with pre/post numbers; customer acknowledged and is monitoring.

tim: Great work. Next steps: maria owns the follow-up fix ticket, alex to restore canary after infra migration completes, sync in Monday standup for full RCA. We'll keep INC-9876 open until SLA window closes. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: incident-bot: INC-9876 set to monitoring.
